# FaceX (vendored)

The browser face stack HAUNT runs on: detection, landmarks, alignment and the EdgeFace embedder, compiled to
WebAssembly. From [facex-engine/facex](https://github.com/facex-engine/facex), Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE` in this folder).
The model weights (`*.bin`) are not committed: the Dockerfile and the server fetch them from the FaceX v1.0.0 release.
